items.alt: The usage page of Agentwright Starter: cost this month, requests, tokens, the plan cap, a 30-day chart, cost by model and recent calls
items.caption: The /usage page each signed-in user sees: cost, tokens, the plan cap and cost by model. The numbers in this screenshot are demo data, recorded through the kit's own metering code.
18 seconds, no sound: a question, a tool call, the streamed answer, then the usage page. A real response from Claude Sonnet 5.5, the kit's default model.

items.alt: The license admin page of Agentwright Starter with three demo licenses: key, buyer, delivery status, downloads, and Resend and Revoke buttons
items.caption: /admin/licenses, for products you sell yourself: issue, resend or revoke a license key. Three demo licenses in a local run; the amber notes show which optional settings are off.
